expedition.budget_unit: one successful authoritative player movement action inside the preserve: ordinary step, Surf step, ledge hop or map-connection crossing step

expedition.continue_policy: Resume saved balls, steps, habitat and position without a new charge or reroll.

expedition.special_ball_storage: Dedicated expedition state, never normal bag inventory.
expedition.required_movement: Native Surf access for the optional preserve: preflight a known SURF partner and the native badge before charging. Mandatory regional through-travel and Q07 remain free and walkable outside.

capture_encounters.bait: For 2–5 wildlife responses: catch-rate factor 1/2 and flee-threshold factor 1/2; replaces prior disposition.

capture_encounters.storage: Use authoritative capture/Pokédex/party/PC delivery. Validate room before entry and handle storage exhaustion inside an encounter without deleting a catch.

navigation_contracts: One connected complete preserve, rendered at once at native proportions. Four habitats are composition regions, not six repeated rectangles.
The optional preserve is designed around native Surf travel; verify known move/native badge before taking admission. Do not invent a canoe movement mode or bypass HM permissions.
Measure genuine connected-water lake channels, paired portage landings and walking/Surf transfer reachability. Preserve safe early retirement from accessible landings.
Water islands require native Surf; canoe is the map theme, not an implemented new movement mode or free HM bypass.
Every unconnected Surf edge uses visible native buoys or water rocks with actual blocking collision.
Only actual reciprocal neighboring map water seams stay open.
Each Cut tree seals a rare habitat/reward/shortcut; full walking+Surf reachability must prove no unintended bypass.
Ledges provide useful one-way returns and honest walking routes back.
Short accessible grass/water choices trade encounter opportunity against the remaining step budget.
The entry gate must be visibly authored and control the only walking approach from paid arrival to the lake launch. Keep admission checks in the free basecamp before charging/warping.

Use six genuine grassy portages with safe lake landings. Two isolate pocket lakes; four connect different arms of the same connected chain with a shorter land crossing and measured paddle alternative. No dry walking bypass around each declared grass neck.

acceptance: No money/balls/steps spent when declining entry or failing preflight.
One accepted entry deducts500 once and gives30 session balls/500 steps.
Blocked movement, turns, dialogue, menus, battle animation and AFK do not spend walking steps.
Actual movement, Surf, ledge and connected-map crossings decrement the documented cost exactly once per transition.
Safari encounters expose Ball/Bait/Rock/Run; normal attack/move/Pack commands are unavailable.
Capture/flee and bait/rock state use deterministic authoritative battle random sources.
Caught Pokémon and earned pickups survive session end and save/Continue.
Exhaustion and early return reach safe free basecamp after the current result without input traps.
Save/Continue cannot refresh the step/ball budget or charge again.
R12→Q07 shelter→R13 and R20 arrival work with zero money and no active Safari session.
Whole-map/player-camera inspection plus Cut/Surf/ledge collision, native gameplay and clean MCP/TUI checks.

Older saves without Safari state load inactive with unchanged party/bag/story. Invalid active zone references or impossible counters fail recoverably, without corrupting the save or losing captured Pokémon.

Whole-map inspection confirms mostly connected lakes with grass/pines around them; actual portage requires dismount, land traversal and relaunch at another landing, and cannot be replaced by a broad dry ring.

safari_balance.status: Original mod design values, not a claim of disassembly-exact Safari behavior.

capture.base: Use native species catch rate, full-HP/no-status encounter and supplied SAFARI_BALL rule in an explicit Safari capture context. Keep native wobble and storage resolution.

flee.rng: One authoritative unsigned 8-bit draw after every failed Ball or completed Bait/Rock command; flee iff draw < threshold. Successful capture and Run do not draw flee RNG.

disposition.duration: On Bait or Rock, draw one native random byte and set 2+(byte &3) response turns.
disposition.stacking: Replace the previous disposition; repeated commands refresh duration without multiplying modifiers.
disposition.response_order: Validate command. Bait/Rock draw duration and set disposition; Ball uses native capture RNG. If uncaught, draw flee using current disposition, then decrement its remaining response turns once. At zero return to neutral.
disposition.reset: Clear on encounter completion; save active state and RNG position on Continue.

composition_contract.primary_geography: Hand-recomposed64x56 linked lake preserve enclosed by pines. Two pocket lakes, six grassy portages and four original camps and two bench rest stops. New Palisade cliff island and double-tier Northwind escarpment add climbable native rock viewpoints and useful one-way returns; the older Granite shelf remains.
composition_contract.lake_connections: Most basins form a single navigable lake chain; exactly two pocket lakes require dry grass portages. Four other portages shorten connected-water alternatives. New cliffs frame real lakes rather than oversized rivers.
composition_contract.portage_definition: Each portage pairs dry dismount/relaunch tiles with actual WATER neighbors and a continuous land path through encounter grass. Pocket-lake crossings have no all-water alternative. Connected-arm crossings must measurably shorten the all-water detour; they need not falsely isolate connected lakes.
composition_contract.shores: Surround the lakes with pine forest. Make land broad enough for real portages, distinct campsite clearings and the Root Beer Lady island; preserve readable navigable lake channels.
composition_contract.entry_gate: A visible native metal fence checkpoint controls the Reed arrival-to-launch path. Closing its two-tile throat must disconnect the forecourt from the launch; no walking bypass through the pine shoulders.
